description: v1 (2026-09-19): the 살핌이 운영감시 mail new-event notice. guild_hall/watchtower/mail_new_event_notice.mjs reads the Watchtower topology snapshot (store_mail_events judgement) and the ingress store_mail_events.json cross-check state, reuses the existing Watchtower alert policy (planAlerts) for suppression and re-notify backoff, and prints at most one fixed-text line.
